title: Sr Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**
 NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to design, scale, and secure our multi\-cloud infrastructure. You will focus on cloud networking and DevOps automation across Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). In this role, you will build resilient infrastructure, optimize network architecture, and drive automated deployments to ensure maximum uptime and performance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Infrastructure as Code: Author, maintain, and scale complex infrastructure modules using Terraform.
* Automation \& Scripting: Develop robust automation scripts using Azure PowerShell to streamline cloud operations.
* Multi\-Cloud Networking: Design and manage secure cloud network architectures, including VPNs, ExpressRoute, Interconnect, and VNets.
* Cloud Security: Implement IAM policies, RBAC, network security, and compliance guardrails.
* CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build and optimize continuous integration and deployment pipelines for zero\-downtime releases.
* Reliability Engineering: Monitor system health, define SLOs/SLIs, and architect self\-healing, highly available cloud systems.
* Incident Response: Lead root\-cause analysis for network and infrastructure disruptions to prevent recurrence. fix system failures and participate in an on\-call rotation.
* Observability: Set up monitoring, logging, and alerts using Splunk, or cloud\-native tools.


**Required Skills And Qualifications**
* University Degree in Engineering B. E, B. Tech, MCA
* Experience: Minimum 5\+ years of dedicated SRE, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering experience.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands\-on expertise managing production workloads in both Microsoft Azure and GCP.
* Primary Tools: Advanced proficiency with Terraform for provisioning and Azure PowerShell for administration.
* Advanced Networking: Deep understanding of DNS, routing, load balancing, firewalls, and hybrid\-cloud connectivity.
* Containers: Strong experience managing containerized environments using Kubernetes (AKS/GKE) and Docker.
* Systems Mindset: Proven track record of improving system reliability, latency, and observability tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Official certifications such as Azure Network Engineer, GCP Cloud Network Engineer, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
* AWS knowledge.
* Experience with Linux/Windows system administration and bash/Python scripting.


 Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job
   

  

**EEO Statement**
 Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.
   

  

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes
   

  

*“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a @ncrvoyix.com email domain.”*

title: DE-Cloud Platform Engineer - AIOps-GDSN02
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family** 
 \-Cloud AIOps \& Automation Engineer
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi\-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world\-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all of our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
   

  

 We are seeking a Cloud AIOps \& Automation Engineer with 4\-8 years of experience to design, implement, and operate intelligent cloud operations solutions. The role combines AIOps, observability, cloud engineering, automation, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to improve platform reliability, reduce operational toil, and accelerate incident resolution.
   

  

 EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Digital Engineering practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Implement AIOps capabilities including anomaly detection, event correlation, alert noise reduction, incident prioritization, and automated remediation.
* Design and maintain observability solutions using logs, metrics, traces, and events.
* Build telemetry pipelines using OpenTelemetry and related technologies.
* Develop automation and self\-healing workflows using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Go.
* Implement AI\-powered operational assistants, incident triage, and RAG\-based knowledge solutions.
* Integrate observability, CI/CD, ITSM, and cloud platforms to improve operational intelligence.
* Support SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, incident management, and reliability improvements.


**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* AIOps and Observability Platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, New Relic, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana)
* Microsoft Azure and/or AWS
* Kubernetes and Containers
* OpenTelemetry and telemetry pipelines
* Python and automation scripting
* GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps
* Incident Management and SRE fundamentals


**Good To Have**
* Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, LangChain
* Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI
* Kafka, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
* Terraform, ArgoCD
* ServiceNow integrations


**Education** 
 :
   

  

**Degree** 
 : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
   

  

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

The role will focus on maintaining platform reliability, resolving complex production issues, driving operational improvements, and supporting the adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, automation, and AI\-enabled solutions.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with technology teams, application teams, and stakeholders to ensure the stability, reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of the Mainframe environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Provide Level 2 / Advanced Technical Support for Mainframe platforms and resolve complex production issues.
* Demonstrate strong hands\-on knowledge of z/OS, JCL, JES, DB2, CICS, MQ, automation, scheduling, storage, networking, and related Mainframe technologies.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting, problem determination, root cause analysis, and resolution of Mainframe incidents and recurring issues.

* Support Mainframe installation, upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and platform changes.
* Drive performance tuning, capacity optimization, availability, and operational stability of Mainframe platforms.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**

**About The Role**
 As a POSITION\_NAME, become a part of a cross\-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Lead the transformation of software development lifecycle into an AI\-agentic model — where autonomous and semi\-autonomous AI agents handle defined portions of requirements analysis, coding, testing, code review, and deployment, under a governed human\-oversight framework. Own both the technical architecture and the organizational rollout.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Assess the current SDLC end\-to\-end and identify which stages are suitable for agent autonomy, agent\-assist, or remain human\-owned (a maturity/readiness map, not a blanket "automate everything")
* Design and stand up the agentic architecture: agent orchestration layer, tool/permission scoping, approval and escalation gates, integration with existing CI/CD and code review systems
* Define and implement guardrails: security review for agent\-generated code, cost/usage controls, rollback and audit mechanisms, human sign\-off checkpoints for high\-risk changes
* Select and integrate the agent tooling stack (build vs. buy decisions across orchestration frameworks, coding agents, testing agents, deployment agents)
* Run a phased rollout (pilot team → expanded pilot → org\-wide) with clear success metrics at each stage — cycle time, defect rate, agent\-error rate, developer trust/adoption
* Own change management: training engineering teams on new workflows, redefining code\-review and QA roles, working with security/compliance on new risk surfaces
* Report to engineering leadership on ROI, risk, and adoption — with honest calibration of what's actually autonomous vs. assisted


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years software engineering experience, including senior/staff\-level architecture ownership
* Demonstrated production experience with AI agent frameworks and LLM tool\-use patterns
* Deep knowledge of modern SDLC/DevOps tooling and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience leading a cross\-functional technology change initiative (not just a technical build)


**Desirable**
* Experience in a regulated or security\-sensitive environment (agent guardrails matter more there)
* Prior consulting/transformation\-program background
* Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent\-tool integration standards


**What’s in it for you?**
* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open\-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large\-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company\-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company\-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial \& legal consultations


**About Us**
 At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting\-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
   

  

 India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game\-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

description:

 Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant – ServiceNow \& Salesforce
 



 Position Overview
 



 We are looking for an
 **Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant** 
 with hands\-on knowledge of
 **ServiceNow and Salesforce** 
 to configure, administer, automate, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise service management and customer operations platforms.
 



 The successful candidate will work across both platforms, translating business requirements into scalable configurations, workflows, integrations, and governed platform solutions. The role requires a strong understanding of
 **IT Service Management (ITSM), CRM, platform administration, automation, scripting, data security, integration, testing, and release management** 
 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ServiceNow Administration \& Configuration
 


* Administer and configure ServiceNow instances, including tables, forms, lists, roles, groups, ACLs, notifications, and scoped applications.
* Configure and support ITSM processes including:
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Enablement
* Request Fulfilment
* Service Level Management
* Work with the CMDB and Common Service Data Model to maintain service\-aware processes.
* Configure UI and data policies, client scripts, business rules, notifications, and other platform components.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using Studio and App Engine Studio.
* Build workflows and automations using Flow Designer and IntegrationHub.
* Configure Service Catalog items, record producers, approvals, and Virtual Agent topics.
* Develop and troubleshoot server\-side scripts using GlideRecord and related ServiceNow APIs.
* Create and consume REST APIs and work with Import Sets and Transform Maps.



 Salesforce Administration \& Development
 


* Configure Salesforce objects, fields, record pages, relationships, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and field\-level security.
* Design scalable Salesforce data models using lookup, master\-detail, and junction relationships.
* Build business automation using Salesforce Flow Builder.
* Configure validation rules, duplicate management, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, and automation where declarative capabilities are insufficient.
* Write efficient SOQL queries and bulk\-safe DML operations.
* Develop and maintain Lightning Web Components.
* Implement appropriate unit testing and asynchronous processing.



 Integration \& Data Synchronisation
 


* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce.
* Work with authenticated APIs, OAuth 2\.0, named credentials, callouts, and platform events.
* Design canonical data models and appropriate integration patterns.
* Configure and support middleware/orchestration solutions such as
 **n8n or MuleSoft** 
 .
* Design conflict\-safe data synchronisation, including duplicate, retry, loop, and failure handling.
* Monitor integrations and troubleshoot data and API issues.



 Governance, Testing \& Release Management
 


* Follow platform governance and enterprise architecture standards.
* Manage platform changes across development, testing, and production environments.
* Work with ServiceNow Update Sets and Salesforce Change Sets/packages.
* Develop and execute automated and unit tests.
* Support release pipelines and controlled deployment processes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, integration documentation, and solution designs.
* Participate in design reviews and platform governance forums.
* Consider licensing, platform cost, maintainability, security, and upgrade impact when proposing solutions.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* Hands\-on experience with
 **ServiceNow administration/configuration** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Salesforce administration/configuration** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **ITIL 4 and ITSM concepts** 
 .
* Understanding of CRM processes and enterprise customer operations.
* Experience with ServiceNow:
* Tables and forms
* Roles and ACLs
* Flow Designer
* Service Catalog
* Business Rules
* Client Scripts
* GlideRecord
* IntegrationHub
* REST APIs
* Import Sets / Transform Maps
* CMDB
* Experience with Salesforce:
* Objects and data modelling
* Profiles and Permission Sets
* Sharing and security
* Flow Builder
* Apex
* SOQL
* Triggers
* Lightning Web Components
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and integration patterns.
* Experience with Git and version\-control practices.
* Experience using tools such as
 **Postman and Visual Studio Code** 
 .
* Ability to analyse business requirements and translate them into platform solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.



 Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or relevant ServiceNow certification.
* Salesforce Administrator certification and/or Salesforce Platform Developer certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow App Engine Studio.
* Experience with Salesforce CLI.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or n8n.
* Knowledge of Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Experience designing cross\-platform integrations.
* Familiarity with automated testing and enterprise release management.
* Basic JavaScript or Python knowledge.



 Educational Qualification
 


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certifications in ServiceNow, Salesforce, ITIL, or enterprise platforms are an advantage.



 Key Competencies
 


* Enterprise platform thinking
* ITSM and CRM process understanding
* Platform configuration and administration
* Workflow and process automation
* Scripting and application development
* API and systems integration
* Data modelling and security
* Troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis
* Testing and quality assurance
* Release and change management
* Technical documentation

 Typical Deliverables

* ITSM workflows and automation
* Salesforce flows and business automation
* Scripts, Apex, and Lightning Web Components
* ServiceNow–Salesforce integrations
* Data synchronisation mechanisms
* Test cases and automated tests

* Deployment packages and release documentation

 Success Profile
 



 The ideal candidate is comfortable working
 **between business processes and technology** 
 . They should be able to understand a business requirement, determine which platform should own the process or data, configure the solution where possible, develop code where necessary, integrate systems safely, test the result, and deploy it through a controlled release process.
 



 This role is particularly suited to professionals working as
 **Platform Administrators, Enterprise Consultants, ServiceNow Administrators, Salesforce Administrators, Platform Developers, or Cross\-Platform Technology Consultants** 
 .

* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.

* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** 
 Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Manager, IT Systems Administration
   

  

**Contract:** 
 Permanent, Full\-time
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
   

  

**Purpose of the Role**
 Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.
   

  

 While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**
* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends


**Cloud Security**
* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments


**Cloud Networking**
* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures


**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**
* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed


**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**
* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments


**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**
* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records


**Minimum**
**What You’ll Need:**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.


**Your Advantage**
* Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Familiarity with IT service management practices (ITIL) and change management processes

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Pioneer Autonomous Security Scale as a Lead AI SecOps Engineer**
 Are you an experienced cloud security and SRE leader ready to own the AI\-driven SecOps strategy for a massive global infrastructure? Trimble is seeking a P3 Lead AI SecOps Engineer to oversee the security architecture, resilience, and automated compliance across our enterprise Azure platform. Operating across a large\-scale estate of 22,000\+ Windows Virtual Machines and 3,000\+ Microsoft SQL Servers, you will combine Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Zero Trust architecture, and AI\-driven automation to ensure our systems remain secure, compliant, and highly available.

For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our SecOps Ecosystem:** 
 Our Global AI Site Reliability \& Security Operations (AI\-SecOps) team integrates cutting\-edge AI tools, autonomous patch orchestration, and DevSecOps pipelines to safeguard Trimble's enterprise infrastructure, ensuring compliance with global benchmarks while protecting global customer workflows.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 As a P3 Lead Engineer reporting directly to the Director of Engineering / Head of Cloud Security, you will have end\-to\-end strategy ownership for multi\-year security roadmaps, autonomous patching frameworks, and AI\-driven CVE remediation. Supporting a follow\-the\-sun model across North America and India, you will serve as a primary technical authority in executive forums, shape Zero Trust adoption, and mentor a high\-performing global engineering team. This position offers a high\-visibility platform to transform enterprise\-level SecOps using modern AI and automation capabilities.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise AI\-SecOps Strategy: Own the AI\-driven SecOps strategy and multi\-year roadmap across our entire Azure infrastructure, setting architecture standards and defining security investment priorities.
* Windows \& SQL Server Infrastructure Security: Define and govern enterprise security architecture and exception frameworks across 22,000\+ Windows VMs and 3,000\+ SQL Servers.
* Third\-Party Patch Governance \& AI Orchestration: Drive global third\-party patch governance (across tools like NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, Ivanti, BigFix), defining autonomous ring\-based rollouts and AI\-assisted troubleshooting standards to eliminate deployment failures.
* Azure Governance, WAF \& Zero Trust: Own enterprise Azure landing zone security, Azure Policy frameworks, RBAC models, Web Application Firewall (WAF) threat thresholds, and Zero Trust adoption.
* AI\-Driven Vulnerability \& CVE Remediation: Direct CVE analysis across platforms (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender) and threat\-intel feeds (NVD, MSRC), leveraging AI agents for triage and automated fix deployments while presenting posture metrics to executive leadership.
* Cloud Resilience \& Global Audit Compliance: Direct DR/BCP strategies, RTO/RPO targets, and compliance execution for ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF/800\-53, and CIS Benchmarks, serving as the lead technical stakeholder for security audits.
* Security Automation \& Global Leadership: Champion security automation using PowerShell, Python, Terraform, and AI Copilots within CI/CD pipelines, while mentoring and leading cross\-functional engineering teams across North America and India.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Professional Experience: 8\+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security, SRE, or enterprise security operations, with proven success operating at 10,000\+ endpoint scale.
* Cloud \& Security Mastery: Deep technical proficiency in Azure, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, WAF, and the Azure Well\-Architected Framework.
* Infrastructure \& Patch Tooling Expertise: Hands\-on experience securing Windows Server and MS SQL Server ecosystems alongside enterprise patch management platforms (Azure Update Manager, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, Ivanti, or BigFix).
* Vulnerability Management \& Frameworks: Expert knowledge of CVE scoring, vulnerability scanners (Defender Vulnerability Management, Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7\), and regulatory standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF/800\-53, CIS Benchmarks).
* Automation \& DevOps: Proficient in PowerShell, Python, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Terraform, and leveraging AI/Copilot tools for DevSecOps automation.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).


**Bonus Points For**
* Certifications: Microsoft AZ\-500, CISSP, Security\+, or equivalent enterprise security credentials.
* Global Team Leadership: Track record of leading, mentoring, and growing global engineering teams across multiple regions and time zones.
* Executive Communication: Experience presenting security posture metrics, risk trade\-offs, and compliance progress directly to C\-suite and executive stakeholders.

From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Build Autonomous Cloud Systems as a Site Reliability Engineer**
 Are you an early\-career engineer passionate about cloud security, site reliability, and automation? Trimble is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (P1\) to join our Global AI Site Reliability \& Security Operations (AI\-SecOps) team. Operating across an enterprise Azure ecosystem of 22,000\+ Windows Virtual Machines and 3,000\+ Microsoft SQL Servers, you will combine SRE principles, Zero Trust architecture, and AI\-driven automation to ensure our systems remain secure, resilient, and highly available.
   

  

**About Us**
 Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
   

  

**Our SecOps \& SRE Ecosystem:** 
 Our AI\-SecOps team integrates cutting\-edge AI capabilities, automated patch orchestration, and DevSecOps pipelines to safeguard Trimble's enterprise infrastructure, ensuring compliance with global benchmarks while protecting global customer workflows.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Great**
 As a P1 Site Reliability Engineer, you will contribute directly to multi\-year cloud security roadmaps, autonomous patching workflows, and AI\-driven CVE remediation under the mentorship of senior engineering leadership. Supporting a follow\-the\-sun model across North America and India, you will gain hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale Azure governance, modern observability tooling, and automated deployment pipelines. This role is an ideal launchpad for an ambitious engineer looking to master cloud reliability at scale.
   

  

 Key Exciting Responsibilities
   

  

* Cloud Infrastructure Support: Support the reliability and security strategy across our Azure infrastructure footprint, assisting in maintaining system stability and performance metrics.
* Windows \& SQL Server Operations: Help apply enterprise security configurations, patching standards, and operational guidelines across 22,000\+ Windows VMs and 3,000\+ SQL Servers.
* Patch Orchestration \& Troubleshooting: Participate in global patch deployment workflows (using tools like Azure Update Manager, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, or Ivanti) to prevent deployment failures.
* Azure Governance \& Security: Assist with Azure landing zone policies, RBAC access controls, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule sets, and Zero Trust security protocols.
* Vulnerability Analysis \& Remediation: Execute routine CVE scans across platforms (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender), utilizing AI tools and scripts for triage and automated patch deployment.
* Automation \& Scripting: Write and maintain scripts in PowerShell, Python, or Terraform to automate administrative tasks, continuous integration gates, and operational runbooks.
* Incident Response \& Collaboration: Support incident triage and root\-cause analysis (RCA) activities while collaborating closely with engineering teams in North America and India.


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Experience: 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in cloud technical support, systems administration, DevOps, or site reliability engineering.
* Cloud \& Security Foundations: Fundamental understanding of Microsoft Azure, Azure Active Directory/Entra ID, RBAC, and basic cloud networking/security concepts.
* Scripting \& Automation: Introductory to intermediate skills in PowerShell or Python for task automation and system scripting.
* OS \& Systems Familiarity: Basic administration knowledge of Windows Server environments and familiarity with relational database management systems like MS SQL Server.
* Analytical Mindset: Strong problem\-solving aptitude, meticulous attention to detail, and a desire to learn modern AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.


**Bonus Points For**
* Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), or CompTIA Security\+.
* Infrastructure as Code: Exposure to enterprise IaC tools such as Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* Vulnerability Management: Familiarity with CVSS scoring, patch management platforms, or common vulnerability scanning tools.

title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer (Fastly, Cloudflare/Akamai)
description:
**About the role:**
 The Gartner SRE team's mission is to deliver reliable, scalable, secure, and high\-performing digital platforms that power Gartner's business and elevate customer experiences through a culture of reliability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 We are seeking a Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to serve as senior technical leader responsible for advancing the reliability, resilience, performance, automation, and governance of Gartner's digital platforms. With a focus on global CDN and edge delivery capabilities, you will shape platform architecture, establish engineering standards, and drive cross\-functional initiatives that improve operational maturity, accelerate delivery, and ensure exceptional customer experiences.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Deliver world\-class availability, stability, and performance for our digital products, ensuring a consistent and positive user experience for customers.
* Establish multi\-CDN architecture patterns, traffic\-steering strategies, failover mechanisms, and operational standards to achieve five\-nines (99\.999%) availability targets.
* Lead CDN incident response, disaster recovery exercises, capacity planning, and performance optimization initiatives to ensure uninterrupted customer experiences during internet\-scale events.
* Partner with Security, Infrastructure, and Application Development teams to implement and optimize edge security capabilities including DDoS protection, WAF policies, bot management, and edge compute services.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions to manage CDN configurations, governance policies, observability, WAF rules, and deployment processes.
* Design, build, and maintain global traffic management policies, including DNS routing, certificate management, and load balancing, to meet disaster recovery (DR) and high\-availability (HA) requirements.
* Design and implement edge\-computing solutions using Cloudflare Workers, Lambda@Edge, or equivalent technologies to address key application use cases.
* Define and monitor CDN\-specific SLOs, SLIs, and KPIs including cache hit ratio, origin offload, latency, availability, and traffic distribution across providers.
* Identify opportunities to improve the performance, scalability, and stability of applications across the full technology stack.
* Participate in operational support and on\-call rotations to provide timely incident response for supported systems and applications.
* Lead production incident resolution efforts, triage application and system issues, identify root causes, and implement remediation measures to restore services quickly.
* Develop alerting strategies, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to communicate operational and business critical metrics.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational work (i.e., “toil”) using pipelines, new software, or any other appropriate mechanisms.
* Drive system design consulting, platform management, capacity planning, and launch reviews.
* Partner with application teams to design and implement chaos engineering practices that improve resilience and fault tolerance.
* Establish strong relationships with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to define and manage Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage, collaborate and share lessons learned regarding CDN architecture and deployments with all stakeholders, including developers, other SREs, operations teams, and project management teams.
* Improve customer experience and increase product value by enhancing the reliability, availability, and performance of client\-facing applications and service
* Internal relationships are critical to establish with application development teams and technology teams such as database, cloud/infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.


**What you will need:**
**Must Have**
* Expert knowledge of one or two enterprise CDN platforms, including Fastly, Cloudflare, CloudFront, Akamai, or equivalent technologies, with hands\-on experience designing, operating, and optimizing multi\-CDN environments.
* Experience implementing multi\-CDN routing and failover solutions using DNS, GSLB, traffic management platforms, or real\-user\-performance (RUM) driven traffic steering.
* Experience in managing large\-scale CDN platforms using Terraform/OpenTofu, CI/CD pipelines, or provider specific automation frameworks such as Fastly VCL, Cloudflare APIs or equivalent.
* Experience with CI/CD pipeline governance, code promotions, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code best practices to enable consistent, automated deployments across environments.
* Expertise in CDN observability, performance analytics, log analysis, and troubleshooting user experience issues across global regions and internet service providers.
* Strong understanding of edge security services including WAF, bot mitigation, DDoS protection, rate limiting, and zero\-trust access controls.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, coupled with strong verbal and written communication capabilities.


**Good To have:**
* Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities and technologies, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Experience in collaborating with Development, Cloud and Architecture teams or other relevant teams to conduct RCA, drive mission critical initiatives
* Experience building Cloudflare Workers and snippets, AWS Lambda@Edge functions, Fastly VCL, and Fastly Compute solutions.
* Experience with client\-side technologies such as NodeJS, JavaScript, React JQuery and utilizing CDN features to improve UI performance
* Hands\-on experience creating ACM certificates in Fastly, Cloudflare, or AWS.
* Exposure with monitoring tools like Splunk, Grafana and APM tools such as Dynatrace, or equivalent
* Proficient in Operating Systems (UNIX/Linux) \& networking concepts.
* Exposure to Performance \& chaos Engineering concepts


**Who you are :**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 8\+ years of information technology experience with 6\+ years working on DevOps/SRE team or similar with focus on CDN.
* Knowledge of Agile approaches to software development and ability to put key Agile principles into practice to deliver solutions incrementally.
* Excellent analytical thinking, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills with strong ability to influence both IT and business partners.
* Ability to prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated experience in people management, team leadership, and fostering a positive team culture.

**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 Klenty is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, automate, secure, and scale the infrastructure and deployment ecosystem that powers our products and engineering teams.
 



 In this role, you will work closely with developers, engineering leaders, and other technical teams to improve the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and efficiency of Voxy’s development and production environments.
 



 The ideal candidate is hands\-on, comfortable owning infrastructure end\-to\-end, and passionate about automation and operational excellence. You should have strong experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and Linux\-based systems, along with a strong troubleshooting mindset.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design, implement, and maintain reliable and secure infrastructure for development, testing, and production environments.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, enabling faster, safer, and more consistent software delivery.
* Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure, with a strong focus on Azure and exposure to other major cloud platforms.
* Design and manage scalable infrastructure across autoscaling compute, networking, and security controls.
* Build, deploy, and maintain containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Implement Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform or OpenTofu to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration.
* Work closely with developers to establish self\-service tools and automation that improve engineering productivity.
* Advance our infrastructure and application security posture across hardening, access control, and DevOps security practices.
* Own and scale our monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident\-response practice to improve system reliability and observability.
* Maintain and improve production environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and scalability.
* Drive continued platform modernization and help evolve engineering processes toward modern DevOps practices.
* Own backup and disaster recovery — including regular restore testing — alongside system administration and operational resilience.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, networking, and production issues and participate in incident resolution.
* Continuously review existing infrastructure and processes against industry best practices and recommend improvements.
* Work closely with cross\-functional engineering teams to improve deployment quality, reliability, and delivery velocity.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation and support critical production systems when required.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 3–4 years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering, or a related role.
* Strong practical experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* Good understanding of Docker and Kubernetes and experience running production workloads in containerized environments.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automating software delivery workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform/OpenTofu or similar Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
* Good understanding of networking, security, system hardening, and production infrastructure.
* Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, and cloud\-native architectures.
* Familiarity with databases, caching, messaging, and supporting infrastructure components is an advantage.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and other engineering teams.
* Good understanding of DevOps principles, automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production (AKS or equivalent).
* Experience operating production datastores, caching layers, message queues, and log/search platforms.
* Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity solutions.
* Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and integrating security into CI/CD workflows.
* Experience migrating applications to modern cloud\-native environments.



  





**Why Join Voxy?** 



* Work on infrastructure supporting a modern, cloud\-based product and engineering environment.
* Take ownership of meaningful initiatives across DevOps, cloud infrastructure, automation, security, and reliability.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams and influence how applications are built, deployed, and operated.
* Work with modern cloud\-native technologies including Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, and observability platforms.
* Help shape engineering practices around automation, reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Join a team where engineers are encouraged to solve problems, take ownership, and continuously improve the platform.
* Opportunity to make a direct impact on the scalability, reliability, and developer experience of Voxy’s technology ecosystem.



  





**Immediate joiner preferred**

title: Senior SRE & Monitoring Developer
description:
Our Product Development (PD) Platform Operations team is responsible for the 24x7 uptime, stability, and performance of our internally customized deployment of the 3DX PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) platform — including its underlying infrastructure, network, and application layers. This platform is mission\-critical to our engineering and manufacturing organizations.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior SRE \& Monitoring Developer who combines deep hands\-on Elastic Stack expertise with strong site reliability engineering practices to help us proactively detect, diagnose, and prevent issues before they impact our internal customers.
   

  

**Elastic Platform Ownership:** 
 Maintain deep expertise in Elastic, including cluster management, performance tuning, index/shard optimization, and Fleet \& APM management. Conduct deep dives into Elastic query performance and resource consumption, specific to the Dassault 3DX product line. Manage index lifecycle policies (ILM) to balance performance, cost, and retention requirements
   

  

**Proactive Monitoring \& Alerting:** 
 Design, implement, and manage comprehensive monitoring and alerting systems across our platforms, with a specific focus on Elastic clusters. Define key metrics (SLIs), thresholds (SLOs), and escalation procedures to proactively identify and address potential issues before they become incidents. Develop and maintain a suite of automated health checks for critical endpoints, APIs, infrastructure components, and network paths
   

  

**Author advanced ES\|QL (Elasticsearch Query Language)** 
 queries to aggregate, transform, and analyze log, metric, and trace data for performance analysis, capacity planning, and root cause investigations.
   

  

**Utilize KQL (Kibana Query Language)** 
 to create efficient search filters, Discover saved views, dashboard controls, and alerting rule conditions. Translate ad\-hoc operational and diagnostic questions into performant ES\|QL pipelines that can be operationalized into Kibana dashboards or scheduled alerts.
   

  

**Design and build advanced custom Kibana visualizations using Vega and Vega\-Lite** 
 for complex use cases beyond out\-of\-the\-box Kibana Lens capabilities (e.g., SLO burn\-rate tracking, multi\-layered service performance visuals, topology maps). Develop and maintain operations, executive, and incident dashboards combining standard Kibana panels with custom Vega visual specifications.
   

  

**Performance Analysis \& Optimization:** 
 Conduct regular performance analysis of platforms, identifying bottlenecks and implementing optimizations to improve responsiveness, scalability, and resource utilization. This includes deep dives into Elastic query performance \& resource consumption – specific to the Dassault 3DX product line
   

  

 Security \& Compliance: Apply appropriate access control (e.g., RBAC in Elastic/Kibana) and follow data handling/security policies relevant to a manufacturing/engineering data environment
   

  

**Automation \& Tooling:** 
 Build and maintain scripts/tools (Python, Bash, or Go) to streamline health checks, monitoring integrations, and routine operational tasks
   

  

**Collaboration \& Enablement:** 
 Work closely with infra teams to ensure the reliability and scalability of applications that interact with Elastic. Provide guidance to engineering teams on Elastic best practices, query optimization, and observability instrumentation
   

  

 Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for monitoring systems, alerting rules, escalation procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Contribute to team runbooks and post\-incident reviews to build institutional knowledge
   

  

 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7 to 10 years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or similar role with a strong focus on monitoring, observability, and incident management
* Experience designing, implementing, and managing monitoring and alerting systems using industry\-standard tools (ELK/Elastic Stack, Dynatrace)
* Experience working with a PLM platform such as Dassault Systèmes 3DX/ Siemens Teamcenter
* Strong scripting or programming skills (Python, Bash, or Go) for automating tasks, developing health checks, and integrating monitoring tools
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure during incidents
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non\-technical teams


 Highly Desirable
   

  

* Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code or Pipeline as a code tools (Ansible, Terraform)
* Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) and cloud\-native monitoring/logging services
* Experience working within an Agile/DevOps environment
* Elastic Certified Engineer certification or equivalent
* Experience in manufacturing or engineering/CAD\-adjacent industries

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About JiBe** 




 JiBe is a cloud based fully integrated ERP system for the shipping industry. Our goal is to allow shipping companies to improve productivity, efficiency and safety levels, while reducing costs. JiBe ERP enables increased automation and streamlining of processes, creating pre\-defined workflows and reducing the usage of email and paper.
 



 For this role JiBe requires a hands\-on engineer operating at the intersection of IT operations, Site Reliability Engineering, and security engineering. The environment is Azure\-first and automation\-first, with AWS as a secondary cloud. You will build and run reliable, secure, automated infrastructure for a multi\-client organization — owning the systems day to day rather than directing others to. Priorities, in order: Azure depth, an automation\-first instinct, hands\-on security engineering, and reliability ownership. AWS, formal compliance ownership, and team leadership are not the focus of this role.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




**Site Reliability Engineering** 



* Define and track SLOs/SLIs and error budgets for core services (Microsoft 365, internal applications, and client\-facing platforms).
* Build observability — metrics, logging, tracing, alerting, and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics).
* Lead reliability\-focused incident response: detection, mitigation, blameless postmortems, and the follow\-up automation that prevents recurrence.
* Systematically reduce operational toil through automation; own platform capacity and performance.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** 



* Author and maintain infrastructure as code (Pulumi, Terraform, or ARM) for Azure and for AWS where used.
* Build automation in PowerShell, Bash, and Python \- integrate with Microsoft Graph and cloud provider APIs.
* Own CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps\- apply config\-as\-code and policy\-as\-code.
* Automate provisioning, patching, identity lifecycle (joiner\-mover\-leaver), and routine security operations.



**Hands\-On Security Engineering** 



* Implement and operate cloud security controls: Microsoft Defender (for Cloud and Endpoint), Microsoft Sentinel, Entra ID Conditional Access, Intune compliance, Key Vault, encryption, and network segmentation.
* Run vulnerability management and remediation; prioritize by business impact and coordinate patching with reliability work.
* Enforce least\-privilege and zero\-trust access (RBAC, PIM, privileged account management).
* Build detections, harden configurations, and automate response with SOAR\-style runbooks.



**Cloud Platform — Azure/AWS** 



* Azure \- Entra ID, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Azure Policy, Key Vault, networking, and Intune, landing\-zone hygiene and cloud security posture management.
* AWS \- IAM, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Security Hub, and KMS for secondary workloads; maintain consistent posture and monitoring across both clouds.
* Integrate network security tooling (FortiGate and FortiClient EMS) with cloud and endpoint controls.



**IT \& Endpoint / Identity Operations** 



* Hands\-on Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Intune, Entra ID).
* Endpoint management and compliance; automated identity lifecycle across a multi\-client / multi\-tenant estate.



**Compliance Support** 



* Implement and evidence the technical controls that support the organization’s security compliance and audit requirements across frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR.
* Produce technical evidence for audits and automate evidence collection where possible.
* Support the compliance program with engineering; this role does not own governance or certification.



  





**Qualifications** 




**Technical Skills** 




**Cloud Platforms:** 



* Strong, hands\-on Azure across identity, security, networking, and governance — must\-have.
* Knowledge of AWS security \- IAM, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Security Hub, and KMS.



**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code:** 



* PowerShell and/or Python, Pulumi or Terraform, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Microsoft Graph.
* An automation\-first mindset — codifying and scripting by default rather than working manually.



**Security Engineering:** 



* Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, and Entra ID with Conditional Access and PIM.
* Least\-privilege and zero\-trust patterns; vulnerability management and remediation.



**Site Reliability \& Observability:** 



* SLOs/SLIs, alerting, and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics).
* Incident response and blameless postmortems.



**Frameworks, Standards \& Supporting Tools:** 



* Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR.
* Microsoft 365 and Intune administration; FortiGate / FortiClient EMS.
* Exposure to Databricks, Power BI Embedded, or Microsoft Foundry is an advantage.



**Soft Skills** 



* Strong problem\-solving and ownership; comfortable carrying reliability for systems they build.
* Clear written and verbal communication; effective across IT, security, and the business.
* Manages competing priorities with attention to detail.
* Written and Verbal English communication is a must.



**Certifications (Preferred)** 



* Azure\-aligned and most relevant: AZ\-104, AZ\-500, SC\-200, SC\-300\.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty is desirable, given the secondary cloud.
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate is a plus.
* CISSP or CISM are welcome but signal a governance/management profile rather than the hands\-on engineering profile this role targets.
